perfil.nombre: Joel A. Abreu De la Rosa
roles: Head of IT at Grupo Corporativo Peguero
perfil.pitch: I lead technology for a group of 5 brands and 13+ locations, and I build the software that runs it: from infrastructure and Microsoft 365 to CRMs, online stores and AI-powered tools.
perfil.disponible: Open to consulting and development projects
sobreMi: I combine two profiles that rarely go together: IT management for a business group and custom software development. Through Twin Mindz, the technology and digital marketing company I co-founded in 2023, I lead technology for Grupo Corporativo Peguero: infrastructure, corporate email, domains, point-of-sale systems, support and IT governance.

When a process has no tool, I build one. That is how TravelHub, the sales CRM for the Group's travel agency, came to be; along with The Bakery's online store with a payment gateway, and CoreFlow, my AI-powered operations hub.

cifras.etiqueta: in-house systems in production or prototype

gestiones.titulo: External IT department for a 5-brand holding company
gestiones.contexto: The Group (Fresarte, The Bakery, Viaja con Cami, Embelléceme and The Wellness House) was growing, with each company handling technology on its own.
gestiones.accion: Through Twin Mindz, I took over IT for the entire Group: infrastructure, email, domains, sales systems, user support and development, within the Shared Services Center that centralizes Finance, HR and Procurement.
gestiones.resultado: One owner and one technical standard across all 5 brands, with IT recognized as a staff function in the corporate manuals.

gestiones.contexto: The companies were using scattered email accounts with no license control.
gestiones.accion: As Microsoft 365 global administrator, I designed and rolled out the Group's corporate email: purchasing and assigning Business Standard licenses, multiple domains and account usage audits.
gestiones.resultado: July 2026 audit: 23 accounts reviewed (19 active, 4 inactive identified), the baseline for monthly license control.

gestiones.contexto: The Group moved from independent companies to a holding structure and needed formal processes.
gestiones.accion: With Twin Mindz we delivered the holding plan, org chart, job manuals and KPIs. I then reviewed the IT procedure (PA.06) in the Shared Services Center manuals, and my feedback was incorporated into the new version.
gestiones.resultado: A formal IT procedure with commitments for technology inventory, license control and an IT budget.

gestiones.titulo: Point-of-sale technology for stores and events
gestiones.contexto: 13+ bakery locations running multiple systems: POS, ERP, e-invoicing and delivery platforms.
gestiones.accion: Support and coordination for Enhorabuena, HIOPOS, ADM Cloud, e-CF, card terminals, mPOS, scales and biometric devices, plus the PedidosYa and Uber Eats channels. mPOS setup for La Ruta Fresarte, with events in 20+ towns.
gestiones.resultado: Uninterrupted sales across stores, delivery and traveling events.

gestiones.titulo: Domains, DNS and web presence for the brands
gestiones.organizacion: Grupo Corporativo Peguero · clientes de Twin Mindz
gestiones.contexto: Domains and websites spread across several providers.
gestiones.accion: Domain and DNS management on Cloudflare and DreamHost, deployments on Railway, and integration of the white-label travel platform into the agency's website.
gestiones.resultado: Websites and online stores running with centrally managed SSL and DNS.

gestiones.contexto: A Dropbox account with 40+ connected devices and scattered marketing content.
gestiones.accion: I set up Google Drive (10 TB) as the content repository for all 5 brands and proposed a Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive architecture with permissions by company and department.
gestiones.resultado: Centralized marketing content and a roadmap to move off Dropbox.

gestiones.titulo: Co-founder and technical lead at Twin Mindz
gestiones.contexto: A digital content agency looking to grow into higher-value services.
gestiones.accion: I lead development, infrastructure, automation and financial tracking. I structured the client portfolio and designed the services quoting tool.
gestiones.resultado: Twin Mindz grew from a content agency into the IT and Marketing arm of a business group, with 15+ external clients.

proyectos.descripcion: CRM and sales system for the travel agency: leads, offers, sales and sales-team tracking. Includes role-based manuals and a finance module in development.
Bakery e-commerce with catalog, cart and an online payment gateway.

Personal operations hub: IT tickets by location, projects, Eisenhower matrix, habits and a hybrid (local + cloud) AI assistant. It triages Gmail and Microsoft 365 email with local AI and turns it into tasks.
KPI dashboard for delivery operations and sales reports by location.
Inventory management by product and size, with users and JWT authentication.
Loyalty program with points, tiers and an Apple Wallet / Google Wallet card for physical stores.
QR landing page that sends customers at each location to leave a Google review.
